Will not recommend new players into this game. Small tip, stick to economy level and get used to all the maps before going to business. Have fun with characters that are in your deck. Get at least to S Card character and max it. For pendant, try to get a dice control pendant. The other 3 pendant slots have fun with the pendants you have from free gacha. For dice, stick to normal dice and play around with the dice control bar while playing the game. Once you are confident with the dice, either upgrade the current one, or get a better dice (look into dice control stat).  Save diamonds and use them sparingly. Game developers want to make you spend cash, even for a few measly cents. As I've stated, game is not recommended for new players. Stay away from Business level until you have a fully max S+ character and 2 or 3 S/S+ class pendants.  The RNG factor in this game is brutal. You can roll a perfect double, and the next thing you know, you end up donating a building to your opponent through the chance card. If you want to play a relaxed game, this is not for you. It is undeniably competitive, and unless you enjoy this Monopoly-style kind of game, this game is not for you.

Monopoly game on steroid where you have to pay your way into winning.  1. Pay2Win should not determine the gameplay - without pay2win, gatcha etc it's very hard to keep up in the game - at one point I somehow think the game is rigged  2. Too frequent updates and changes - newer cards, pendants, dice etc are almost impossible to beat, and to keep up you have to either be very lucky or spending money on trying to get the good character/pendants/dice etc.  3. Match should be based on capability/rank/level. Oftentimes we're in battle with 0 chance of winning against the mighty new S+30 cards with S+7 pendants and new dice.   4. Too many things going on with the game: enhancing character, enhancing pendants etc. The main point is, the game maker really tries hard to make you buy your way into winning.   All and all, I'm a simple girl looking for a simple classic online Monopoly game. Not a whatever map with whatever special capability that dismiss the heart of Monopoly strategy.

There are many aspects of this game which requires luck. However, the game is designed in such a way that the luck is badly skewed towards you not succeeding. An item that gives you 50% chance of succeeding in doing something, more often than not, gives you less than 50% chance. There was one time when I used 8 of the same items that give 50% chance of succeeding. All 8 times failed consecutively. What are the chances of such a phenomenon happening?  Another phenomenon happening is the "weakening" of your character card. After you have just spent some money getting your new "all-powerful" character, it activates its skill fairly often. But after 2-3 weeks, for some unknown reason, the skills start activating less and less. Until you literally want to tear your hair out and wonder why the card is suddenly so weak. These occurrences are not isolated cases. I have been playing for more than a year and i see the same thing happening over and over again. The game simply wants you to keep spending to keep up with the newer cards. I had enough.
